مقدمة
This document outlines 
 the equipment inspection checklist I1, to be carried out every three 
 months as indicated by M3 in the title block.
The Control & 
 Protection of Feed Water Pump consist ل:
Release 
 و Protection feed water pumps:
a- Level Switches
b- Flow Transmitters.
c- RTDs
d- Sol. Valves of Minimum Flow
e- Limit Switches on Suction and discharge Valves
و- جهاز الدوران الخلفي
g- Pressure switches.
h- Local gauge.
Control of main 
 flow valves
a- Position transmitters
b- Flow transmitters
c- Limit switch & torque switch
For testing protection system perform the following:
Each protection loop have ( sensor, switch, software logic, I/O electronic 
 modules and final control element test )
The first draft initiated by 
 eng. Mohamed Gomaa, tested by eng Waled Wahba, revised by EDEPC quality control
